title: Opium
tagline: Dashboard for Opium Protocol and Opium.Team's products.
description:
Dashboard allows you:
- Browse your positions on Opium Protocol
- See actual data on oracles used in Opium.Team's projects
- See current state of Opium Protocol (COMING SOON)
- See payout charts and derivatives information of synthetics used in Opium.Team's projects
how_its_made:
We used React and MobX for frontend development, alongside with Web3.js and Web3Modal, TheGraph protocol for getting on-chain data from Chainlink and Opium Protocol, NodeJS on proprietary backend to perform authentication and retrieve some on-chain data.



Also we used Portis, WalletConnect, Metamask, Fortmatic wallets.

For the deployment Sia Skynet.
